name: Saikon Aite no Tsureko to Muramura Kichau Papa
original_name: 再婚相手の連れ子とムラムラ来ちゃうパパ
source: Protagonist's wife goes on a trip for one month, leaving him alone with his stepdaughter Miki, who he is secretly attracted to.
